thread:
cara: Quick notefound a set of near-duplicates in seedbank slipping past fuzzy>=0.9 causing canary eval noise.
ben: how many?
cara: ~1k pairs in the ambiguous band (0.85-0.9). quick query: `SELECT id, fuzzy_score FROM seedbank WHERE fuzzy_score BETWEEN 0.85 AND 0.9 LIMIT 1000;`
alice: saw disagreement spike on dev goldset yesterday. likely related.
dan: proposal: add cheap secondary check (shingle_jaccard > 0.65) and surface gray-zone pairs to labelers instead of auto-dropping.
evie: embeddings would be ideal but heavier. shingle/jaccard is good tradeoff.
cara: plan: 1) run sweep and queue label-bot job, 2) create 200-pair micro-golden for manual adjudication, 3) add tie-break rule but gate behind micro-golden pass.
ben: ensure sampler prioritizes these (weight bump) so labelers see them.
dan: patching sampler: `priority_rules: - condition: fuzzy_score >=0.85 AND fuzzy_score <0.9 -> weight: 12`
label-bot: created job seedbank-gray-1755987654 with 980 pairs; reviewers: alice, evie.
alice: I'll run micro-golden review with marta. will report conflicts here.
evie: added `jaccard_shingles(text,k=4)` to infra.dedupe; perf ~4% hit for batch.
cara: acceptable for one-off. also export token_len_diff and kvcache_est to inspect quantization risk.
dan: added fields to export.
label-bot: progress: 340 completed, 22 ambiguous, 5 conflicts escalated.
alice: adjudicating conflicts now. will surface rule tweaks (templated placeholders etc.).
cara: if micro-golden passes, we'll flip canary next Tue. add runbook note about dedupe change so SRE/runtime expect small metric shifts.
ben: noted. thanks everyone.
